messages:
anne: Noticed canary telemetry spike after we renamed routing header to `x-rd-route` — some SDKs are dropping route metadata and quotas show gaps. Can we triage?
bryan: Which SDKs? Logs?
kevin: Repro: Go and Py still emit `x-rd-route-meta` and TS emits `x-rd-route` but with a slightly different JSON shape (missing `quota_scope`). Console now only reads `x-rd-route` strict parse.
sophia: Short-term: console should accept both headers and try lenient parse of legacy shape. I can add tolerant parsing in staging today.
release-bot: Patch queued: CONS-1304 tolerant header parsing -> staging.
kevin: SDK plan: ship Go/Py patch to write both headers; TS to write legacy for 1 minor release for compatibility.
bryan: Also add migration telemetry: count legacy vs new header per minute and a ratio. We need a dashboard tile and an alert if legacy ratio > 0.2 after 7 days.
monitor-bot: Dashboard tile created: `headers.legacy_ratio` and alert rule `>0.2 for 7d` -> pages #incidents.
sophia: Also add an e2e that posts mixed headers and asserts quota attribution unchanged. I'll add to canary smoke.
kevin: I'll open Go PR now to emit both headers and include unit tests.
anne: Messaging: publish a short integrator note + changelog entries in SDK releases. Timeline: console tolerant parsing today, SDK patches within 48h, metrics + alert live, deprecation notice for 30 days, then cut legacy support at 60 days.
bryan: +1. Keep the rollout notes minimal and include migration snippets for each language.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood/go-sdk/pull/802 (draft)
anne: Thanks — follow up in #platform-integrations when patches land.
